name: Micron Technology, Inc.
research_rationale: FY2026 10-K and TTM cash flows corroborate the strong-buy screen, but absent model metrics and memory-cycle price swings keep research conviction at accumulate, not full alignment.

weekly_updates.summary:
FY2026 10-K (filed 9 Oct) is in the corpus; Yahoo annual data show about $133bn revenue and ~$59bn GAAP free cash flow versus ~$1.7bn FCF in FY2025.  
Shares fell sharply on 20–21 Nov, then rose ~19% on 23 Nov with the wider chip rally after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang; coverage also cites a large fund adding MU in Q3.  
Quantitative screen is now strong buy; news mixes AI memory narratives with cyclical valuation caution—filing-based risk picture unchanged.

News since the last refresh adds more Nvidia-led rally coverage (MU up roughly 18–20% on 23 Nov) and President DeBoer’s rival DRAM versus 3D DRAM comments; no new filings or sourced financials.  
Screen remains strong buy with TTM FCF about $59bn in the snapshot; zero quantitative models passed in the screen.  
Filing-based cyclical, leverage and concentration risks are unchanged—moves look sentiment-led.
